# Running loopvec itself under GOEXPERIMENT=simd must still analyze the scalar
# sources, including packages whose files are guarded by !goexperiment.simd.

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
loopvec -split .
! stderr 'build constraints'
! stdout .
! stderr .

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
//go:build !goexperiment.simd

package test

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
